fields.label: Image Path Field
fields.help: Item field holding the local image path. Defaults to image_path, path, file_path, or media_path (first non-empty).

fields.label: Width (px)
fields.help: Target width. At least one of width or height is required.

fields.label: Height (px)
fields.help: Target height. At least one of width or height is required.

fields.label: Fit Mode
fields.help: contain: fit within bounds keeping aspect ratio; cover: fill and center-crop; fill: stretch to exact size; width/height: set only that dimension.

fields.label: Output Field
fields.help: Item field where the output file path is written.

fields.label: Output Directory
fields.help: Directory for the resized file. Defaults to the source image's directory. ~ is expanded.
